newsitem.title: JAPAN: Israel diamond firm to buy stake in Hohrin - paper.
newsitem.headline: Israel diamond firm to buy stake in Hohrin - paper.

text.p: Lorenzi Diamond Ltd of Israel plans to take a 44 percent stake in Japanese jewellery importer Hohrin Co Ltd, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.
Spokesmen for both Lorenzi and Hohrin were not immediately available for comment on the report.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily said that the Israeli diamond exporter would buy the shares from founder and former chairman of Hohrin, Tadahiko Ura, for a total of about 1.91 billion yen.
The purchase would take place by September 24, the paper said.
